notes: The accepted entrance is held in place while inward source distances are doubled and the deep half bends under the existing mountain.
The separate valley-boulder plug and its 2,953 triangles are removed.

The retained TRELLIS shell is locally smoothed and contracts into a measured inner-wall lining; side walls, ceiling and floor converge into a rounded blind end without daylight openings or a flat cap.
The measured walkable route from the entrance grows from about 27 m to about 49.5 m, approximately twice the former playable depth.
All fourteen paintings are on the east or west wall beyond the new chamber midpoint; the cat and 524 creature remain on opposite walls at different depths.
The outdoor starting campfire and cave entrance position are unchanged.
